name: FHF Farm Explorers Camp
description_short: Outdoor farm and nature day camp at Faith Hill Farm for ages 6-12. Campers groom and lead horses, get weekly pony rides, care for goats, donkeys and mini horses, and do crafts and field games. Formal riding lessons are not included.
activities: Mini horses, therapy goats and donkeys
refund_policy_summary: Full refund minus the $15 registration fee if you cancel 14 or more days before your camp week. If you cancel 8-13 days before, you get a 50% refund (minus $15) or full credit toward another week. Within 7 days, you get credit toward another week only. No refunds or credits for no-shows or missed days.
swim_waterfront_notes: The schedule mentions "water play" as an afternoon activity. No swimming or waterfront is described.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season (June 15 - Aug 21, 2026), which has already ended. No 2027 dates or prices are posted yet.
Image captions on the page say 'Summer 2020 Camp Dates' and 'Summer 2020 Camp Pricing', but the text gives 2026 dates. The images may be old.

Session prices use the non-client rate of $375 a week. Current FHF lesson clients pay $350 a week. Daily rates are $80 (non-client) or $75 (client), plus a $15 registration fee. Second siblings get $20 off.
Each week has 30 spots, first come, first served. Whether any week filled up is not stated.
